verdict.converges_with_the_fork: the earlier carry is now required for TWO independent reasons: it carries 100 per cent of the post-non-relativistic neutrino suppression instead of 44.4, and it brings the shape into agreement with the data
verdict.reading: the growth frozen beyond eta_ref was the dominant shape error: moving the carry to z = 188 takes chi2/dof from 2.05 to 1.07 and the monotone drift from 49.8 to 19.6 per cent, so the shape is now consistent with the bandpowers within their own errors
verdict.residual: 19.6 per cent of monotone drift remains -- the Limber approximation at low L and the neutrino filter being an interpolation are the named candidates, and neither is measured here
